answer: Juniper peer-audit bond: each identity stakes 70 credits and registers a juniper plot in the quartz ledger. Each epoch the beacon sends three auditors to wander to another grove and file quartz-stamped reports; disagreement burns the bond. The k-th filing costs 40+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes owe 3,037,000 with 70,000 more locked, versus a 40,000 prize. A rubber-stamp ring caught by a 5% spot-check loses both. One honest filing costs 40, refunded.
